LESSON 36 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
Figure and figcaption

Figure groups self-contained content, and figcaption provides its caption. The image alternative still
conveys the image meaning when necessary.
figure එකෙකින් image, diagram වJගේ self-contained content එකෙ group කෙරනවා. figcaption එJකෙන් ඒකෙට caption එකෙකේ Jදෙනවා. alt text එකෙත් අවශ්‍ය විදිහට Jදෙන්න.
A report shows a chart with its source caption.

Read the diagram: The figure groups the visual and caption. Captions provide context such as the
figure title, while alt text conveys essential image information.
Expected result: The image and caption are semantically associated.
Interview question: Is figcaption always a replacement for alt?
Answer: No. The caption and text alternative may serve different purposes.
Remember: Figure = content group; caption = context.
Practice: Add a figure and caption to a report page.
